surface.name: Graph view
surface.body: Peer to the reading room. Renders the cold layer as a typeset diagram via ELK.js layout + xyflow. Lenses (ownership / surfaces / code / territory); filter bar across the top; selected node populates a right-side detail rail (compact mirror of the reading room's detail). Double-click → leave graph, open the entity in the reading room. The peek drawer is shared via PeekProvider, so code anchors still open inline on the right.

region.name: Filter bar
region.role: Top strip inside the graph view. Lens selector (radio row), kind toggles, context multiselect, edge-class toggles, and search input (focused via `/`).

region.name: Canvas
region.role: The diagram itself. xyflow canvas over ELK positions: pan, zoom, native node drag, fit-to-viewport on first paint. Cluster boxes keep four-corner ticks. Nodes per kind, edges per kind (solid oxide / dashed vellum / dotted saffron). Click selects; double-click navigates out to the reading room.

region.name: Detail rail
region.role: Right column inside the graph view. Compact rendering of the selected entity — definition / statement / status / affects / supersedes / code anchors — with a "open in reading room" link back. Resizable, width persists via `usePersistedWidth`.
